title: Landing page CTA routes authenticated users to dashboard

requirements.summary: Update Landing page primary CTAs to route authenticated users to /dashboard and unauthenticated users to /signin using existing TanStack Router navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is authenticated (Internet Identity identity is present), clicking the Landing page "Get Started" button navigates to /dashboard.
When the user is authenticated, clicking the Landing page "Order Now" button navigates to /dashboard.
When the user is not authenticated, clicking either Landing page button navigates to /signin.
This change is implemented in frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx and does not require changes to the auth provider hooks in immutable paths.

file_operations.description: Import and use the existing useInternetIdentity() hook to detect whether identity is present, then update the "Get Started" and "Order Now" onClick handlers to navigate({ to: isAuthenticated ? '/dashboard' : '/signin' }) while keeping the existing @tanstack/react-router useNavigate approach; do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts.
